root.name: Semi-Slav Defense: Anti-Moscow Gambit
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 c6 3. Nf3 Nf6 4. Nc3 e6 5. Bg5 h6 6. Bh4

overview: White pins with Bg5, and after 5...h6 6.Bh4 Black can take on c4 and White plays 7.e4 g5 8.Bg3 b5 9.Be2, a sharp pawn race in which Black has an extra pawn and White has the centre and development. Black can also decline with 6...Be7. Theory is long and forcing.

white_ideas.idea: Build the centre with e4 and e5
Develop and use the open lines against Black's weakened kingside
Regain the pawn with a4 or pressure

typical_structures.structure: White centre pawns d4/e4 vs Black pawns b5/c6/g5

character.notes: Mutual risk with a pawn race and many forcing lines.

gambit.notes: White gives the c4 pawn that Black can keep.

soundness.notes: Anti-Moscow is a respected top-level line.

approach.notes: Standard line; Moscow Variation is mainstream.

sublines_that_differ.name: 6...Be7
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 e6 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. Nf3 c6 5. Bg5 h6 6. Bh4 Be7
sublines_that_differ.how: Black declines and the position is a quiet Semi-Slav; no material changes hands.

gambit.reason: White gives the c4 pawn in the main line.

structure.reason: White central pawns versus open lines.

level.reason: Long forcing lines must be known.

plans.reason: White tries to use the centre and speed.
